questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
A woman wanted to kill a business competitor. She contacted a man who she believed was willing to commit murder for hire and offered him $50,000 to kill the competitor. The man agreed to do so and accepted $25,000 as a down payment. Unbeknownst to the woman, the man was an undercover police officer.
In a jurisdiction that has adopted the unilateral theory of conspiracy, is the woman guilty of conspiracy to murder the business competitor?

choices.A: No, because it would have been impossible for the woman to kill the competitor by this method.
choices.B: No, because the man did not intend to kill the competitor.
choices.C: Yes, because the woman believed that she had an agreement with the man that would bring about the competitor's death.
choices.D: Yes, because the woman took a substantial step toward bringing about the competitor's death by paying the man $25,000.

questions.explanation:
Conspiracy
Agreement Overt act
Majority view
(modern & MPC)		 Unilateral approach – at least one person specifically intends to enter agreement At least one conspirator must commit overt act
Minority view
(common law)		 Bilateral approach – two or more persons specifically intend to enter agreement Not required
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Conspiracy occurs when:

  • two or more persons enter an agreement with the specific intent to commit a crime and
  • in most jurisdictions, an overt act is committed in furtherance of that agreement.

The common-law bilateral theory of conspiracy required proof of at least two guilty minds, so a defendant could not be convicted if the other conspirators had feigned agreement. But most jurisdictions now follow the unilateral theory of conspiracy, where only one guilty mind is required. This means that a defendant can be convicted even if the other conspirators feigned agreement to commit the crime.

Here, the woman hired a man to kill her business competitor (agreement and intent) and gave him a $25,000 down payment (overt act). Therefore, the woman is guilty under the unilateral theory of conspiracy even though the man (an undercover police officer) did not intend to commit the crime (Choice B). But had this jurisdiction followed the bilateral theory of conspiracy, the man's feigned agreement would have absolved the woman of this crime.

(Choice A) It would have been impossible for the woman to kill the competitor by this method since the man was an undercover police officer. But the woman is still guilty since factual impossibility is no defense to conspiracy.

(Choice D) The facts state that the jurisdiction adopted the unilateral theory of conspiracy, but there is no indication that the jurisdiction also adopted the overt-act requirement. And even if it had, the overt-act requirement merely requires discernible evidence that a conspiracy was at work—a conspirator need not satisfy the more stringent substantial-step test required under the majority rule for attempt.

📌 Educational Objective

The unilateral theory of conspiracy requires only one guilty mind, so a defendant is guilty even if the other conspirators feigned agreement to commit the crime. But since the bilateral theory requires two guilty minds, a defendant would not be guilty if the other conspirators feigned agreement.

📚 References
  • 16 Am. Jur. 2d Conspiracy § 16 (2019) (discussing the unilateral theory of conspiracy).
questions.zh-question:
一名女子想杀死一名商业竞争对手。她联系了一名她认为愿意受雇杀人的男子，并向他要约支付50,000美元以杀死该竞争对手。该男子同意了，并接受了25,000美元作为定金。该女子不知道的是，这名男子是一名卧底警察。

在一个采纳了共谋单方理论的司法管辖区内，该女子是否犯有共谋谋杀该商业竞争对手的罪行？

zh-choices.A: 不成立，因为该女子通过这种方法杀死竞争对手是不可能的。
zh-choices.B: 不成立，因为该男子并无意图杀死该竞争对手。
zh-choices.C: 成立，因为该女子相信她与该男子达成了一项会导致竞争对手死亡的协议。
zh-choices.D: 成立，因为该女子通过支付该男子25,000美元，为导致竞争对手的死亡采取了实质性步骤。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点精讲

Criminal Law: Conspiracy
核心考点：共谋的单方理论 (Unilateral Theory) 本题考察的是共谋罪（Conspiracy）中关于“协议”（Agreement）认定的两种不同理论。这是MBE刑法部分的高频考点。
普通法 (Common Law) - 双方理论 (Bilateral Theory)
要求至少两人拥有真实的犯罪意图（Two Guilty Minds）。如果一方是卧底警察或假装同意，则不构成共谋。
现代法/MPC - 单方理论 (Unilateral Theory)
本题适用规则
仅要求被告人有真实的犯罪意图并相信达成了协议。即使另一方是假装的（如卧底），被告人依然构成共谋罪。
案情分析

在本案中，女子（被告）具有杀死竞争对手的特定意图（Specific Intent），并且她相信自己已经与该男子达成了协议。

尽管该男子是卧底警察（Undercover Officer），并没有真实的犯罪意图，但题目明确指出该司法管辖区采用单方理论 (Unilateral Theory)。

因此，只要被告单方面具备“意图”和“达成协议的认知”，共谋罪即成立。

选项深度解析
选项 C (正确答案)
"成立，因为该女子相信她与该男子达成了一项会导致竞争对手死亡的协议。"
这准确描述了单方理论的核心：关注被告人的主观罪过（Culpability）。只要她相信协议存在，另一方是否真心同意在所不问。
选项 B (错误 - 常见陷阱)
"不成立，因为该男子并无意图..."
这是双方理论 (Bilateral Theory) 下的抗辩理由。如果题目说这是普通法（Common Law）管辖区，这个选项才是对的。但在单方理论下，卧底警察没有意图并不影响被告的定罪。
选项 A (错误)
"事实不能 (Factual Impossibility)"
虽然因为警察卧底导致谋杀不可能成功，但在共谋罪（以及未遂罪）中，事实不能从来不是有效的抗辩理由 (No defense)。
选项 D (错误 - 混淆概念)
"实质性步骤 (Substantial Step)"
这是未遂罪 (Attempt) 的标准。共谋罪通常只需要一个公开行为 (Overt Act)，而不需要达到“实质性步骤”的程度。虽然支付定金确实是公开行为，但选项D的表述侧重于未遂罪的标准，且没有点出本题的核心考点（单方 vs 双方协议）。
💡 MBE 答题技巧
看到“卧底警察 (Undercover Police)”参与共谋，立即检查题目适用的规则：
如果是 Common Law → 无罪 (需两人)；
如果是 MPC / Unilateral → 有罪 (仅需一人)。

reason.en: Identifies the governing conspiracy rule in the jurisdiction.
reason.zh: 表明本案适用的共谋规则。

reason.en: Shows the alleged agreement to commit the murder.
reason.zh: 显示涉嫌实施谋杀的合意。

reason.en: Provides evidence the conspiracy was underway.
reason.zh: 表明共谋已开始实施。

reason.en: Means the other party never truly intended the crime.
reason.zh: 说明另一方并无真实犯罪故意。

reason.en: Suggests factual impossibility defeats conspiracy, which it does not.
reason.zh: 暗示事实不能犯可阻却共谋，但并非如此。

B.text: did not intend to kill the competitor

reason.en: Invokes the bilateral theory requirement that both parties intend the crime.
reason.zh: 套用双边共谋理论下双方都须有故意的要求。

C.text: believed that she had an agreement

reason.en: Captures the unilateral theory: one guilty mind is enough.
reason.zh: 体现单方共谋理论：只需一方具备共谋故意。

reason.en: Mistakes the attempt doctrine for conspiracy.
reason.zh: 把未遂罪标准误当成共谋要件。

highlights.text: a jurisdiction that has adopted the unilateral theory of conspiracy

reason.en: This sentence supplies the controlling legal standard.
reason.zh: 这句话直接给出适用的法律标准。

highlights.text: The man agreed to do so

reason.en: Shows why the woman may think a conspiracy existed.
reason.zh: 说明女方为何认为存在共谋。

highlights.text: accepted $25,000 as a down payment

reason.en: Supports the existence of conduct in furtherance of the plan.
reason.zh: 支持存在推进犯罪计划的行为。

highlights.text: Unbeknownst to the woman, the man was an undercover police officer

reason.en: This is the key fact testing unilateral versus bilateral conspiracy.
reason.zh: 这是考查单方与双边共谋区别的关键事实。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
A foreign diplomat discovered that a small person could enter a particular jewelry store by crawling through an air vent. The diplomat befriended a woman he met in a bar who he believed was small enough to crawl through the air vent. Without telling her that he was a diplomat, he explained how she could get into the jewelry store. She agreed to help him burglarize the store. Someone overheard their conversation and reported it to the police. Shortly thereafter, the police arrested the diplomat and the woman. Both were charged with conspiracy to commit burglary.
Before trial, the diplomat moved to dismiss the charge against him on the ground that he was entitled to diplomatic immunity. The court granted his motion. The woman then moved to dismiss the conspiracy charge against her. The jurisdiction has adopted the Model Penal Code version of conspiracy.
Should the court grant the woman's motion to dismiss the conspiracy charge against her?

choices.A: No, because the diplomat's defense does not negate any element of the crime.
choices.B: No, because the woman was not aware of the diplomat's status.
choices.C: Yes, because a conspiracy requires two guilty participants.
choices.D: Yes, because but for the diplomat's conduct, no conspiracy would have occurred.

questions.explanation:
Conspiracy
Agreement Overt act
Majority view
(modern & MPC) 		Unilateral approach – at least one person
specifically intends to enter agreement 		At least one conspirator must
commit overt act
Minority view
(common law) 		Bilateral approach – two or more persons
specifically intend to enter agreement 		Not required
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Under the Model Penal Code (MPC) and in most jurisdictions, conspiracy requires proof that:

  • a person entered into an agreement to commit a crime with the specific intent to commit that crime and
  • one of the conspirators committed an overt act in furtherance of that agreement.

This definition of conspiracy departs from the traditional view that there must be at least two guilty parties to form a conspiracy. As a result, another conspirator's guilt (or lack thereof) has no effect on the defendant's liability.

Here, the diplomat and the woman were charged with conspiracy after they agreed to burglarize a jewelry store. The conspiracy charge against the diplomat was dismissed due to his diplomatic immunity. But the diplomat's immunity defense does not affect the woman's liability for conspiracy since this MPC jurisdiction only requires proof of one guilty participant (Choice A). As a result, her motion to dismiss this charge should be denied.

(Choice B) The woman's awareness of the diplomat's status has no bearing on her liability for conspiracy.

(Choice D) Although the diplomat's conduct was a but-for cause of the conspiracy, his actions do not excuse the woman's criminal liability. Instead, those actions support her conviction since they satisfy the overt act requirement.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the Model Penal Code (MPC), conspiracy occurs when (1) a person enters into an agreement with the specific intent to commit a crime and (2) any conspirator commits an overt act in furtherance of that agreement. Therefore, the MPC only requires proof of one guilty participant.

📚 References
  • Model Penal Code § 5.03 (Am. Law Inst. 2019) (criminal conspiracy).
questions.zh-question:
一名外国外交官发现，一个身材矮小的人可以通过爬过通风口进入一家特定的珠宝店。该外交官在酒吧结识了一名女子，他认为这名女子身材足够矮小，可以爬过通风口。他没有告诉她自己是外交官，而是向她解释了如何进入珠宝店。她同意帮助他犯下入室犯法罪。有人无意中听到了他们的谈话并报了警。不久之后，警方逮捕了该外交官和该女子。两人均被指控共谋实施入室犯法罪。

在审判前，该外交官以其享有外交豁免权为由，请求驳回对他的指控。法院批准了他的请求。随后，该女子也请求驳回对她的共谋指控。该司法管辖区采纳了《Model Penal Code》中关于共谋罪的规定。

法院是否应批准该女子驳回共谋指控的请求？

zh-choices.A: 不应批准，因为外交官的抗辩理由并未否定该罪行的任何构成要件。
zh-choices.B: 不应批准，因为该女子并不知道外交官的身份。
zh-choices.C: 应批准，因为共谋罪要求有两名有罪的参与者。
zh-choices.D: 应批准，因为若非外交官的行为，共谋便不会发生。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law: Conspiracy
正确答案：A

不应批准，因为外交官的抗辩理由并未否定该罪行的任何构成要件。

核心考点：单边理论 (Unilateral Theory)

本题的关键在于题目明确指出该司法管辖区采纳了《模范刑法典》(Model Penal Code, MPC)。

在共谋罪 (Conspiracy) 的认定上，MPC 采用单边理论 (Unilateral Approach)。这意味着：

  • 共谋罪的成立仅关注被告人 (Defendant) 的主观意图和行为。
  • 只要被告人相信自己与他人达成了实施犯罪的协议，共谋即成立。
  • 另一方的情况无关紧要： 即使另一方是卧底警察（假装同意）、无行为能力人、或如本案中享有外交豁免权 (Diplomatic Immunity) 的人，都不影响被告人的刑事责任。
法律分析

1. 构成要件未被否定：
该女子具有实施入室盗窃的意图 (Intent)，并与外交官达成了协议 (Agreement)。根据 MPC，这已满足共谋罪对她的定罪要求。

2. 个人抗辩 (Personal Defense)：
外交官的豁免权是一种程序性抗辩或个人抗辩。它并不意味着“共谋”这个事实没有发生，只是法律禁止对外交官进行起诉。这种针对个人的保护伞不能延伸给该女子。

MPC vs. Common Law (普通法)
比较维度 普通法 (Common Law) 模范刑法典 (MPC)
理论基础 双边理论 (Bilateral) 单边理论 (Unilateral)
核心要求 必须有两个或以上有罪的参与者 (Two guilty minds)。 只要被告人意图达成协议即可。
一方脱罪的影响 如果一方被宣告无罪(Acquitted)，另一方通常也不能定罪。 不影响。一方的身份或抗辩不影响另一方的定罪。

为什么选项 C 错误？
选项 C ("共谋罪要求有两名有罪的参与者") 描述的是普通法 (Common Law) 的规则。如果题目没有注明适用 MPC，或者注明适用 Common Law，C 可能是正确答案。但在 MPC 规则下，这是错误的法律陈述。

💡MBE 答题技巧：
在做 Criminal Law 的题目时，务必第一时间寻找题目中是否提及 "Model Penal Code"。

如果是 MPC 辖区，涉及 Conspiracy (共谋) 时，永远记住：一个人的独角戏也可以构成共谋（只要他认为对方是真心的）。不要被同伙的疯癫、豁免权或卧底身份迷惑。

reason.en: Signals the jurisdiction uses the MPC unilateral approach, not common law bilateral conspiracy.
reason.zh: 表明本题适用MPC单边共谋，而非普通法双边共谋。

reason.en: The diplomat's personal defense is central to whether his status affects the woman's liability.
reason.zh: 外交官的个人抗辩决定其身份是否影响女方责任。

reason.en: Identifies the offense whose elements and participant requirements are at issue.
reason.zh: 指出争议罪名及其构成要件。

reason.en: Frames the question as whether the charge should be dismissed before trial.
reason.zh: 说明问题是庭前是否应驳回指控。

reason.en: Captures the MPC rule that only one culpable conspirator is needed.
reason.zh: 概括MPC只需一名有罪共谋者即可成立的规则。

A.text: defense does not negate any element

reason.en: Correctly states that immunity does not erase the woman's conspiracy elements.
reason.zh: 正确指出豁免并不消灭女方共谋要件。

B.text: not aware of the diplomat's status

reason.en: Awareness of the diplomat's status is not required for her conspiracy liability.
reason.zh: 女方是否知晓外交官身份并非其共谋责任要件。

C.text: a conspiracy requires two guilty participants

reason.en: Invokes the common-law rule that the MPC rejects.
reason.zh: 援引MPC已抛弃的普通法双边规则。

reason.en: But-for causation is not the issue; the diplomat's conduct does not excuse liability.
reason.zh: 并非因果关系问题，外交官行为也不免除责任。

highlights.text: The jurisdiction has adopted the Model Penal Code version of conspiracy

reason.en: This is the controlling rule because MPC uses a unilateral conspiracy approach.
reason.zh: 这是决定性规则，因为MPC采用单边共谋。

highlights.text: the diplomat moved to dismiss the charge against him on the ground that he was entitled to diplomatic immunity

reason.en: Shows why the diplomat is not being tried, but his immunity does not control the woman's liability.
reason.zh: 说明外交官为何不受审，但其豁免不决定女方责任。

highlights.text: The woman then moved to dismiss the conspiracy charge against her

reason.en: Directly presents the motion the court must decide.
reason.zh: 直接提出法院必须裁定的动议。

highlights.text: She agreed to help him burglarize the store

reason.en: Supplies the agreement element needed for conspiracy.
reason.zh: 提供共谋所需的协议要件。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
An art thief planned to steal a three-dimensional piece of hanging installation art from a modern art museum. Her plan involved dressing up like a museum docent, temporarily closing off the room that contained the installation art, and in the one minute it took for the security camera to visually sweep the rest of the room, hiding the installation art in a covered garbage can. Before the police or museum security would think to search a garbage can, the art thief would then disguise herself as part of the janitorial crew and remove the garbage can containing the installation art from the museum. However, on the day she planned to execute her heist, the art thief found out that the museum had recently installed hidden GPS tracking devices on all of the art pieces in the museum. The art thief decided to postpone her heist until she could figure out how to disable the GPS device and avoid getting caught. A few days later, the art thief was arrested by the police based on security footage from the museum that showed the art thief engaged in suspicious activities like stealing docent and janitorial uniforms and timing the security cameras.
Can the art thief be charged with attempted larceny of the artwork?

choices.A: No, because the element of "asportation" was not satisfied.
choices.B: No, because she abandoned the crime before it occurred.
choices.C: Yes, because she took a substantial step toward stealing the artwork.
choices.D: Yes, because attempted larceny is a general intent crime.

questions.explanation:
Attempt
(inchoate crime)
Mens rea
(specific intent) 		Actus reus
(overt act)
Common law Intends to commit
target offense		 Dangerous-proximity test – performs act sufficiently close to completing target offense
Majority & MPC Substantial-step test – engages in conduct that exceeds mere preparation & strongly corroborates criminal intent
MPC = Model Penal Code.

A defendant is guilty of attempted larceny if the defendant:

  • specifically intended to commit larceny
  • committed an act in furtherance of the larceny but
  • did not complete the larceny.

In most jurisdictions, an act occurs under the substantial-step test when the defendant's conduct exceeds mere preparation and strongly corroborates the defendant's criminal intent—i.e., the defendant has taken a substantial step toward the commission of the target crime. As a result, if a defendant has taken a substantial step toward committing the target crime but then abandons (i.e., withdraws from) the crime due to a change of heart, the defendant remains liable for attempt.

Here, the art thief specifically intended to steal art from the museum (i.e., commit larceny). She took substantial steps in furtherance of the theft when she stole docent and janitorial uniforms and timed the security cameras. And though the art thief later postponed her heist, the crime of attempt was completed once she took those substantial steps (Choice B). Therefore, the art thief can be charged with attempted larceny of the artwork.

(Choice A) Larceny is the trespassory taking and carrying away (i.e., asportation) of another's personal property with the intent to permanently deprive the owner of that property. However, attempted larceny requires a substantial step toward committing the larceny (as seen here)—not asportation.

(Choice D) For a general intent crime, the criminal act must be consciously performed. However, attempt is a specific intent crime because the criminal act must be consciously performed for a particular purpose. Therefore, the art thief must have had the specific intent to commit the larceny (as seen here).

📌 Educational Objective

Attempt requires that the defendant (1) had the specific intent to commit a crime and (2) took a substantial step toward committing the crime but (3) did not complete it. So, if a defendant has taken a substantial step but then abandons (i.e., withdraws from) the crime due to a change of heart, the defendant remains liable for attempt.
questions.zh-question: 一名艺术品窃贼计划从一家现代艺术博物馆盗窃一件三维悬挂式装置艺术品。她的计划包括：打扮成博物馆讲解员，暂时关闭存放该装置艺术品的房间，并在安保摄像头扫视房间其他区域的一分钟内，将装置艺术品藏在一个带盖的垃圾桶里。在警察或博物馆安保人员想到搜查垃圾桶之前，该艺术品窃贼会伪装成清洁人员，并将装有装置艺术品的垃圾桶从博物馆移走。然而，在她计划实施盗窃的那天，该艺术品窃贼发现博物馆最近在所有艺术品上都安装了隐藏的 GPS 追踪设备。该艺术品窃贼决定推迟盗窃，直到她能弄清楚如何禁用 GPS 设备并避免被抓。几天后，警方根据博物馆的监控录像逮捕了该艺术品窃贼，录像显示该窃贼从事了可疑活动，例如偷窃讲解员和清洁人员制服以及计算安保摄像头的时间。该艺术品窃贼能否被指控犯有艺术品“盗窃未遂”（attempted larceny）？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为“转移占有”（asportation）这一要素未满足。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为她在犯罪发生前放弃了犯罪。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为她为盗窃艺术品采取了实质性步骤（substantial step）。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为“盗窃未遂”（attempted larceny）是一种一般意图犯罪（general intent crime）。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

刑法与刑事诉讼法: 未遂犯与共犯

正确答案是 C

因为被告人已采取了实质性步骤，即使后来放弃，仍可被控未遂盗窃。

核心法律规则：未遂犯

未遂犯 (Attempt / Inchoate Crime)

未遂犯是一种未完成犯罪 (inchoate crime)，指行为人意图实施某项犯罪，并采取了超出单纯准备阶段的行动，但最终未能完成该犯罪。构成未遂犯需要满足 主观犯意 (mens rea) 和 客观行为 (actus reus) 两个要素。

被告人构成 未遂盗窃罪 (attempted larceny)，需满足以下条件：

  • 明确意图 (specifically intended) 实施盗窃罪；
  • 实施了促进盗窃罪的 行动 (act)，该行动已超出单纯的准备阶段；但
  • 未完成 (did not complete) 盗窃罪。

在多数司法管辖区，判断客观行为是否构成未遂犯，采用 实质性步骤测试 (substantial-step test)。根据该测试，当被告人的行为已 超出单纯的准备阶段 (exceeds mere preparation) 并 强烈印证了犯罪意图 (strongly corroborates criminal intent) 时，即视为已采取了实质性步骤。一旦被告人采取了实质性步骤，即使后来因改变主意而放弃（即撤回）犯罪，被告人仍对未遂犯承担责任。

概念比较：未遂犯的构成要素

未遂犯要素 主观犯意 (Mens Rea) 客观行为 (Actus Reus)
普通法 (Common Law) 意图实施目标犯罪 (Intends to commit target offense) 危险接近测试 (Dangerous-proximity test) – 实施的行为已充分接近完成目标犯罪
多数管辖区与MPC (Majority & MPC) 意图实施目标犯罪 (Intends to commit target offense) 实质性步骤测试 (Substantial-step test) – 实施的行为已超出单纯的准备阶段，并强烈印证了犯罪意图

案件事实与法律适用

本案中，艺术窃贼明确意图盗窃艺术品（即实施盗窃罪）。她采取了多项实质性步骤以推进盗窃计划：她偷窃了博物馆讲解员和清洁工的制服，并计时了安全摄像头的巡视时间。根据多数管辖区和 模范刑法典 (Model Penal Code, MPC) 的 实质性步骤测试，这些行为已超出单纯的准备阶段，并强烈印证了她的犯罪意图。

尽管艺术窃贼后来因发现 GPS 追踪设备而推迟了盗窃计划，但一旦她采取了这些实质性步骤，未遂罪即告完成。她推迟计划是由于外部情况变化（发现 GPS），而非自愿且完全放弃犯罪。因此，该艺术窃贼可以被控未遂盗窃艺术品。

未遂犯行为流程图

计划盗窃艺术品 (主观犯意)
➡️
偷窃制服、计时监控 (实质性步骤 / 客观行为)
➡️
发现GPS、推迟计划 (未完成犯罪)
➡️
被捕 (仍承担未遂责任)

MBE 陷阱提示：放弃与责任

在 MBE 考试中，一个常见的陷阱是关于犯罪放弃 (abandonment) 的问题。一旦被告人已采取了构成“实质性步骤”的行动，未遂罪即告完成。此时，即使被告人后来因改变主意而自愿放弃了犯罪，只要这种放弃不是因为外部因素导致不可能完成犯罪，其仍需承担未遂罪的责任。只有当放弃是完全自愿且彻底的，并且是在未采取实质性步骤之前发生的，才可能作为辩护理由。

正确答案与干扰项排除

C. 正确。艺术窃贼明确意图盗窃艺术品，并采取了偷窃制服、计时监控等实质性步骤。一旦这些实质性步骤完成，未遂罪即告成立，即使她后来推迟了计划，也无法免除责任。
A. 错误。盗窃罪的“转移占有” (asportation) 要素是指将他人财产非法带走。然而，未遂盗窃罪不要求完成“转移占有”，只需采取实质性步骤即可。本案中，虽然尚未发生转移占有，但已满足未遂犯的客观行为要求。
B. 错误。一旦被告人采取了构成“实质性步骤”的行动，未遂罪即告完成。即使被告人后来放弃了犯罪，只要放弃不是因为外部因素导致不可能完成犯罪，其仍需承担未遂罪的责任。本案中，窃贼因发现 GPS 而推迟计划，但已完成实质性步骤，故不能免责。
D. 错误。未遂盗窃罪是 特定意图 (specific intent) 犯罪，要求被告人明确意图实施目标犯罪。虽然犯罪行为本身必须是自觉实施的，但未遂罪要求行为人有实施特定犯罪的特定目的。因此，艺术窃贼必须具有盗窃的特定意图。

考试技巧

未遂犯要求被告人 (1) 具有实施犯罪的特定意图，(2) 采取了实施犯罪的实质性步骤，但 (3) 未完成犯罪。如果被告人已采取了实质性步骤，但后来因改变主意而放弃（即撤回）犯罪，被告人仍对未遂犯承担责任。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
An 18-year-old student and his 14-year-old girlfriend made plans to meet in the student's apartment to have sexual intercourse, and they did so. The girlfriend later told her mother about the incident.
The student was charged with statutory rape and conspiracy to commit statutory rape. In the jurisdiction, the age of consent is 15, and the law of conspiracy is the same as at common law. The student was convicted of both charges and given consecutive sentences.
On appeal, he contends that his conspiracy conviction should be reversed.
Should the student's conviction be affirmed or reversed?

choices.A: Affirmed, because he agreed with the girlfriend to commit the crime.
choices.B: Reversed, because one cannot conspire with a person too young to consent.
choices.C: Reversed, because the crime is one that can only be committed by agreement and thus Wharton's Rule bars conspiracy liability.
choices.D: Reversed, because the girlfriend could not be a conspirator to this crime.

questions.explanation:
Conspiracy
Agreement Overt act
Majority view
(modern & MPC)		 Unilateral approach – at least one person specifically intends to enter agreement At least one conspirator must commit overt act
Minority view
(common law)		 Bilateral approach – two or more persons specifically intend to enter agreement Not required
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Common law jurisdictions follow the bilateral theory of conspiracy, which requires proof that two or more persons entered an agreement with the specific intent to accomplish a criminal act. In other words, there must be at least two guilty minds—the defendant and another conspirator. But when the agreed-upon act was criminalized to protect a certain class of persons, members of that class cannot supply a guilty mind. As a result, these protected persons cannot be convicted of the target crime or conspiracy to commit it.

Here, the 18-year-old student was convicted of conspiracy to commit statutory rape after he and his 14-year-old girlfriend agreed to have sexual intercourse. And though the student likely had a guilty mind since he specifically intended to commit this crime, the girlfriend could not supply the other guilty mind. That is because this jurisdiction's statutory-rape law is designed to protect persons under 15 years old—like the girlfriend (Choice D). As a result, there was no conspiracy and the student's conviction should be reversed.

(Choice B) A victim's consent is not a defense to conspiracy (or statutory rape) since consent does not negate an element of either crime. And regardless, persons can conspire with anyone who has the capacity to consent (ie, make reasonable judgments). So though the girlfriend was not too young to enter a conspiracy, she could not do so here because she is the type of person the statute was designed to protect.

(Choice C) Wharton's Rule bars liability for conspiracy to commit a crime that requires at least two culpable parties (eg, dueling, adultery, bigamy) and the crime is completed by only the necessary number of parties. But this rule does not apply here since the girlfriend cannot be culpable under the statutory-rape statute.

📌 Educational Objective

Common law conspiracy requires proof that at least two persons entered an agreement with the specific intent to accomplish a criminal act (ie, bilateral theory). But when the conspired act violates a statute designed to protect members of a given class, a member of that class cannot be guilty of the criminal act or conspiracy to commit it.

一名18岁的学生与他14岁的女友计划在该学生的公寓见面并发生性关系，他们也确实这么做了。女友后来将此事告知了她的母亲。

该学生被控法定强奸罪以及共谋实施法定强奸罪。在该司法管辖区，同意年龄为15岁，且共谋法与普通法相同。该学生两项罪名均被定罪，并被判处连续服刑。

在上诉中，他主张应撤销其共谋罪的定罪。

对该学生的定罪应予以维持还是撤销？

zh-choices.A: 维持，因为他与女友合意实施该犯罪行为。
zh-choices.B: 撤销，因为不能与一个年龄过小而无法表示同意的人构成共谋。
zh-choices.C: 撤销，因为该罪行是一种只能通过合意才能实施的犯罪，因此Wharton's Rule排除了共谋责任的成立。
zh-choices.D: 撤销，因为女友不能成为此项罪行的共谋者。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

共谋罪与受保护群体

正确答案：D

撤销 (Reversed)，因为女友不能成为此项罪行的共谋者。

本题的核心考点在于共谋罪 (Conspiracy) 在涉及受保护群体 (Protected Class) 时的特殊规则。

⚖️ 法律规则解析

题目明确指出该司法管辖区遵循普通法 (Common Law) 的共谋规则。普通法的共谋罪适用双边理论 (Bilateral Theory)。

双边理论 (Bilateral Theory)：
共谋必须由两个或两个以上具有“有罪意图” (Guilty Mind) 的人达成合意。如果其中一方不能被定罪（例如是卧底警察或受法律保护的人），则另一方也不能单独构成共谋罪。
🛡️ 受保护群体例外原则

这是一个关键的立法意图原则 (Legislative Intent Exception)：

  • 如果一项犯罪的设立是为了保护特定群体（如未成年人、高利贷受害者），那么该群体的成员不能被视为该犯罪的共谋者或帮凶。
  • 在本案中，法定强奸罪 (Statutory Rape) 的设立是为了保护未达到同意年龄（15岁）的未成年人。

逻辑推导：

  1. 14岁的女友是法律旨在保护的受害者。
  2. 因此，她不能成为法定强奸罪的共谋者（她没有法律上的“有罪意图”）。
  3. 由于女友不能成为共谋者，剩下的只有18岁的被告一人。
  4. 根据普通法双边理论，一人无法构成共谋。

为什么不选 C (Wharton's Rule)?

这是一个极具迷惑性的选项。Wharton's Rule 通常适用于那些本质上必然需要两人参与的犯罪（如通奸 Adultery、重婚 Bigamy、乱伦 Incest、决斗 Dueling）。

规则内容：如果犯罪本身必然需要两人，除非参与人数多于犯罪构成要件所需的人数，否则不能控告共谋。

不选 C 的原因：虽然法定强奸看似需要两人，但 Wharton's Rule 适用的前提是两人都具有可归责性 (Culpability)。在本案中，因为女友是受保护方，她根本不承担刑事责任。因此，排除共谋责任的首要原因是“受保护群体原则”，而不是 Wharton's Rule。

为什么不选 A?

虽然事实上有“合意” (Agreement)，但在法定强奸案中，法律视未成年人的同意为无效。更重要的是，由于她属于受保护阶层，她的“合意”不能构成共谋罪所需的犯罪合意。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 刑法题中，如果看到成年人 + 未成年人（或受害者）共同实施某种犯罪：

  1. 首先判断该法规是否旨在保护该未成年人。
  2. 如果是，该未成年人不能成为共谋者。
  3. 如果是普通法辖区（双边理论），成年被告的共谋罪名通常不成立。
MBE Criminal Law Review

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
A landlord decided to destroy his dilapidated building in order to collect the insurance money. He hired a man to burn down the building. The man broke into the building and carefully searched it to make sure no one was inside. The man failed, however, to see a person experiencing homelessness asleep in an office closet. The man started a fire. The building was destroyed, and the person experiencing homelessness died from burns a week later. Two days after the fire, the landlord filed an insurance claim in which he stated that he had no information about the cause of the fire.
The landlord is charged with felony murder of the person experiencing homelessness.
If the landlord is found guilty, it is because the death of the person experiencing homelessness occurred in connection with which felony?

choices.A: Arson.
choices.B: Burglary.
choices.C: Conspiracy.
choices.D: Fraud.

questions.explanation:
Accomplice liability

(accomplice liable for encouraged and foreseeable crimes)

Accomplice liability arises when a person intentionally aids, encourages, or solicits another (principal) to commit a crime with the intent that the crime be completed. An accomplice is liable to the same extent as the principal for the encouraged crime and any crimes that occur as a natural and probable (ie, foreseeable) consequence of that crime.

Here, the landlord became an accomplice when he hired the man to burn down his building (ie, solicited arson). The landlord did not encourage the commission of felony murder—the killing of another during the commission, or attempted commission, of an inherently dangerous felony like arson. But he still could be found guilty of felony murder since the person experiencing homelessness died from burns caused by that fire (foreseeable consequence of arson).

(Choice B) Burglary is an inherently dangerous felony that requires proof of a (1) trespassory entering of another's property (2) with the specific intent to commit a crime therein. Although the man intended to commit arson in the landlord's building, he did not trespass because the landlord consented to his entry (no burglary).

(Choice C) Criminal conspiracy occurs when (1) two or more persons enter an agreement with the specific intent to commit a crime and (2) one of the conspirators commits an overt act in furtherance of that agreement. Although the landlord and the man conspired to commit arson, the felony murder conviction must be based on an inherently dangerous felony—not their conspiracy.

(Choice D) Fraud requires proof that the defendant made a false representation with the specific intent to permanently obtain the victim's property. But since fraud is not an inherently dangerous felony, it can never be the basis for felony murder.

📌 Educational Objective

An accomplice is someone who intentionally aids, encourages, or solicits another to commit a crime with the intent that the crime be completed. As a result, an accomplice is liable for the encouraged crime and any crimes that occur as a natural and probable consequence of that crime.
questions.zh-question:
一名房东为了骗取保险金，决定摧毁其破旧的建筑物。他雇佣了一名男子来放火烧毁该建筑物。该男子闯入建筑物，并仔细搜查以确保里面没有人。然而，该男子未能发现一名在办公室壁橱里熟睡的流浪汉。该男子点燃了火。建筑物被烧毁，流浪汉一周后因烧伤死亡。火灾发生两天后，房东提交了保险索赔申请，声称他对火灾原因一无所知。

房东被指控犯有针对该流浪汉的 felony murder。

如果房东被判有罪，其定罪依据是该流浪汉的死亡与下列哪项重罪有关？

zh-choices.A: Arson.
zh-choices.B: Burglary.
zh-choices.C: Conspiracy.
zh-choices.D: Fraud.

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考题解析

Inchoate Crimes & Felony Murder

正确答案：A. Arson (纵火罪) 房东被判 Felony Murder (重罪谋杀) 的基础重罪是 Arson。
⚖️ 法律推理深度解析

1. 共犯责任 (Accomplice Liability)

房东雇佣他人烧毁建筑，构成了 Solicitation (教唆)。一旦受雇人实施了犯罪，房东作为 Accomplice (共犯/从犯)，不仅要对被教唆的罪行 (Arson) 负责，还要对该罪行产生的自然的、可预见的后果 (Natural and Probable Consequences) 负责。

2. 重罪谋杀规则 (Felony Murder Rule)

该规则规定，如果在实施内在危险性重罪 (Inherently Dangerous Felony) 的过程中导致他人死亡，被告可被控谋杀。

  • 基础重罪 (Predicate Felony)： 本案中，受雇人点火烧毁建筑的行为构成了 Arson。
  • 因果关系： 流浪汉的死亡是火灾（Arson）的直接结果。
  • 结论： 既然房东对 Arson 负有共犯责任，且死亡是 Arson 的可预见后果，那么 Arson 就是支持 Felony Murder 指控的基础重罪。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错误的？
B. Burglary (入室盗窃/夜盗)

这是本题最大的陷阱。Burglary 需要证明 "Breaking and Entering" (破门入户) 且具有 "Trespassory" (非法侵入) 的性质。因为房东拥有该建筑并同意受雇人进入，所以不存在非法侵入 (Trespass)，因此不构成 Burglary。

C. Conspiracy (共谋)

虽然房东和受雇人确实构成了 Conspiracy，但 Felony Murder 必须基于一项内在危险性重罪 (Inherently Dangerous Felony)。Conspiracy 本身通常被视为一种独立的未遂类犯罪 (Inchoate Crime)，而不是导致死亡的直接危险行为。定罪的基础是放火行为 (Arson)，而非协议行为。

D. Fraud (欺诈)

房东意图骗保确实涉及 Fraud。但是，Fraud 通常不被视为 "Inherently Dangerous Felony" (如强奸、抢劫、纵火、入室盗窃等 BARRK crimes)。因此，它不能作为 Felony Murder 的基础。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：

1. BARRK 记忆法： 常见的支持 Felony Murder 的重罪包括 Burglary, Arson, Rape, Robbery, Kidnapping。

2. 识别 "Consent" (同意)： 在涉及 Burglary 的题目中，如果所有者同意被告进入，通常会否定 "Breaking" 或 "Trespass" 元素，从而通过排除法排除 Burglary。

3. 共犯的延伸责任： 记住共犯不仅对目标犯罪负责，还对过程中发生的可预见后果（包括意外死亡）负责。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
A state statute provides as follows: "The maintenance of any ongoing enterprise in the nature of a betting parlor or bookmaking organization is a felony."
A prosecutor has evidence that a woman has been renting an office to a man, that the man has been using the office as a betting parlor within the meaning of the statute, and that the woman is aware of this use.
Which of the following additional pieces of evidence would be most useful to the prosecutor's effort to convict the woman as an accomplice to the man's violation of the statute?

choices.A: The man has paid the woman the rent in bills that are traceable as the proceeds of gambling activity.
choices.B: The woman charges the man considerably more in rent than she charged the preceding tenant, who used the office for legitimate activities.
choices.C: The woman has personally placed bets with the man at the office location.
choices.D: The woman was previously convicted of running a betting parlor herself on the same premises.

questions.explanation:
Exclusions from accomplice liability
Member of
protected class		 Members of class criminal statute was designed to protect are immune from liability (eg, statutory rape)
Exempted
necessary party		 When crime requires multiple participants but criminal statute only imposes liability on one, others are immune from liability (eg, sale of narcotics)
Withdrawal No liability if accomplice voluntarily withdraws before crime becomes unstoppable by:
  • repudiating encouragement
  • undoing or neutralizing assistance
  • notifying authorities or otherwise preventing crime

A person who aids or encourages another (ie, the principal) before or during a crime can only be convicted as an accomplice if those acts were intended to further the principal's criminal aim. Mere knowledge that the principal intends to commit a crime is not enough to prove the intent necessary for accomplice liability. But such intent can be inferred from evidence that the person has a personal stake in the commission of the crime.

Here, the woman knew that the man was using the office she rented to him as an illegal betting parlor. And her intent to aid or encourage his crime could be inferred from evidence that she personally benefits from his operation by charging him considerably higher rent than she charged the preceding tenant. Therefore, this evidence would be most useful to the prosecutor's effort to convict the woman as the man's accomplice.

(Choice A)  Evidence that the man's rent payments are traceable to gambling activity would not show that the woman intended to further his crime.

(Choice C)  Although maintaining a betting parlor requires more than one participant (operator and customer), the statute only imposes liability on one participant (operator). So evidence that the woman acted as a customer (an exempted necessary party) by placing bets at the office would exclude her from accomplice liability.

(Choice D)  The woman's prior conviction of running a betting parlor on the same premises would be irrelevant since it would not show that she intended to help the man with his criminal enterprise.

📌 Educational Objective

An accomplice must aid or encourage the principal with the intent to further the principal's criminal aim. Such intent can be inferred when the accomplice has a personal stake in the crime being committed.
questions.zh-question:
一项州法律规定如下：“维持任何具有博彩店或博彩组织性质的持续性企业均构成重罪。”

一名检察官有证据表明，一名女子将一间办公室出租给一名男子，该男子一直将该办公室用作该法律含义范围内的博彩店，并且该女子知道此用途。

以下哪一项额外证据对于检察官努力将该女子作为该男子违反法律行为的共犯定罪最有用？

zh-choices.A: 该男子支付给该女子的租金所用的钞票可被追溯为博彩活动的收益。
zh-choices.B: 该女子向该男子收取的租金远高于她向前一个将办公室用于合法活动的租户收取的租金。
zh-choices.C: 该女子曾亲自在该办公室与该男子下注。
zh-choices.D: 该女子曾因在同一场所亲自经营博彩店而被定罪。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

刑法：共犯责任与意图
✅ 正确答案：选项 B

该女子向该男子收取的租金远高于她向前一个将办公室用于合法活动的租户收取的租金。

核心法律原则

本题考察的是共犯责任 (Accomplice Liability) 中的核心要素：犯罪意图 (Mens Rea)。

根据普通法和大多数司法管辖区的规定，要成为共犯，被告必须具备双重意图：

  1. 意图协助主犯的行为；
  2. 意图促进犯罪的完成 (Intent that the crime be committed)。
深度解析：知情 vs. 意图

这是 MBE 刑法部分的一个经典考点，通常被称为 "Supplier of Goods or Services" (商品或服务提供者) 问题。

一般规则：单纯知情不足以定罪
仅仅知道他人将利用你提供的服务（如出租房屋、出售电话服务）进行犯罪，通常不足以证明共犯所需的“意图”。
Mere knowledge is generally insufficient for accomplice liability.

例外：利益相关 (Stake in the Venture)
如果服务提供者在犯罪活动中有“个人利害关系” (Stake in the Venture)，法院允许陪审团从中推断出犯罪意图。

为什么选项 B 是最强证据？

当房东收取的租金远高于市场价（或前任合法租户的价格）时，这表明：

  • 房东正在收取“风险溢价”。
  • 房东的超额利润直接依赖于非法生意的成功（如果是合法生意，租户不会支付这种高价）。

这种超额收费确立了房东在犯罪中的利益相关性，从而可以推断她不仅“知道”，而且“希望”该非法博彩店继续经营，以维持她的高额租金收入。

为什么其他选项不够好？
选项 A (钞票来源)：
这仅证明她收到了钱，且钱来自赌博。但这只能证明“知情” (Knowledge)，无法证明她为了获取利益而积极希望犯罪成功。卖三明治给毒贩并收到毒资，并不让你成为贩毒共犯。
选项 C (亲自下注)：
这会让该女子成为“顾客”。根据惠顿规则 (Wharton's Rule) 或相关成文法解释，如果法律旨在惩罚经营者，通常会将“必要的参与方” (Necessary Parties)（如购买违禁品的顾客、赌客）排除在共犯责任之外。作为顾客下注不能证明她作为房东协助经营的意图。
选项 D (前科记录)：
先前的定罪属于品格证据 (Character Evidence)。虽然它可能显示该女子熟悉博彩业，但它不能直接证明她在本次特定交易中意图协助该男子犯罪。且此类证据通常因偏见过大而被排除。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“供应商/房东 + 犯罪客户”的题目时，请寻找以下能证明意图 (Intent) 的加分项（参考 People v. Lauria 案）：

  1. 在非法商品中占有股份/分红（Stake in the venture，如本题的高额租金）。
  2. 该服务除了犯罪外没有合法用途。
  3. 交易量巨大，与合法需求不成比例。

如果没有这些因素，仅凭“知情”通常选“无罪”。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
A man was engaged to marry a woman. One evening, the man became enraged at the comments of the woman's eight-year-old daughter, who was complaining, in her usual fashion, that she did not want her mother to marry the man. The man, who had had too much to drink, began beating the daughter. The daughter suffered some bruises and a broken arm. The woman took her daughter to the hospital, and the police were notified by the hospital staff.
The man was indicted for felony child abuse. He pleaded with the woman to forgive him and to run away with him. She agreed. They moved out of state and took the daughter with them. Without the testimony of the child, the prosecution was forced to dismiss the case. Some time later, the woman returned for a visit with her family and was arrested and indicted as an accessory after the fact to child abuse.
At the woman's trial, how should the court proceed?

choices.A: Dismiss the charge, because the evidence shows that any aid the woman rendered occurred after the crime was completed.
choices.B: Dismiss the charge, because the man had not been convicted.
choices.C: Submit the case to the jury, on an instruction to convict only if the woman knew the man had been indicted.
choices.D: Submit the case to the jury, on an instruction to convict only if the woman's purpose in moving was to help the man avoid conviction.

questions.explanation:
Parties to a crime
Modern view Common law Definition Liability
Principal Principal
(first degree)		 Performs criminal act with requisite intent or uses innocent agent to commit criminal act Target &
foreseeable
crimes
Accomplice Principal
(second degree)		 Present at crime & aids/encourages principal with intent that principal commit crime
Accessory
before the fact*		 Not present at crime but aids/encourages principal with intent that principal commit crime
Accessory
after the fact		 Knows principal has committed felony & helps principal avoid arrest or conviction Independent
crime
*Common law liability requires conviction of principal.

A person is an accessory after the fact if he/she:

  • knew that the principal had committed a felony
  • aided or assisted the principal after the felony was complete and
  • did so for the purpose of helping the principal avoid apprehension or conviction.

Although the accessory after the fact is not liable for the principal's crime, the accessory is liable for a separate crime—often "harboring a fugitive" or "obstructing justice."

Here, the man was indicted for felony child abuse after beating the woman's daughter. Although the woman was aware of this crime, she moved out of state with the man and her daughter. This move helped the man avoid conviction since the daughter's unavailability to testify forced the state to dismiss his case. But the jury should only convict the woman as an accessory after the fact if her purpose in moving was to help the man avoid conviction.

(Choice A) The evidence that the woman aided the man after the crime was completed supports her liability as an accessory after the fact—not a dismissal of the charge.

(Choice B) A person can be convicted as an accessory after the fact even if the principal has not been prosecuted for, or convicted of, the completed felony.

(Choice C) An accessory after the fact must know that the principal has committed a felony but need not know that the principal has been indicted for that crime.

📌 Educational Objective

An accessory after the fact (1) knows that the principal has committed a felony, (2) aids or assists the principal after the felony is complete, and (3) does so to help the principal avoid apprehension or conviction.
questions.zh-question:
一名男子与一名女子订婚。一天晚上，该女子八岁的女儿像往常一样抱怨说，她不希望母亲嫁给该男子。该男子听后勃然大怒。该男子因饮酒过量，开始殴打该女孩。女孩身上多处瘀伤，手臂骨折。女子将女儿送往医院，医院工作人员通知了警方。

该男子因重罪虐待儿童罪被起诉。他恳求女子原谅他并与他一同私奔。女子同意了。他们带着女儿搬离了本州。由于没有女孩的证词，检方被迫撤销了此案。一段时间后，该女子回家探亲时被逮捕，并被控为虐待儿童罪的事后从犯。

在对该女子的审判中，法院应如何处理？

zh-choices.A: 驳回指控，因为证据显示该女子提供的任何帮助都发生在该罪行完成后。
zh-choices.B: 驳回指控，因为该男子尚未被定罪。
zh-choices.C: 将案件提交给陪审团，并指示只有在该女子知道该男子已被起诉的情况下才能定罪。
zh-choices.D: 将案件提交给陪审团，并指示只有在该女子搬家的目的是为了帮助该男子逃避定罪的情况下才能定罪。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law: Parties to a Crime
核心考点：事后从犯 (Accessory After the Fact)

本题考察的是认定事后从犯所需的“特定意图” (Specific Intent)。仅仅提供帮助是不够的，必须是为了阻碍正义。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 D)

法院应指示陪审团：只有当该女子搬家的目的是为了帮助该男子逃避定罪时，才能将其定罪。

法律依据：

构成 Accessory After the Fact 需要满足以下三个要素：

  1. 重罪已完成 (Completed Felony)： 主犯必须已经实施了重罪。
  2. 明知 (Knowledge)： 被告必须知道主犯实施了该重罪。
  3. 特定意图的协助 (Assistance with Specific Intent)： 被告必须亲自协助主犯，且目的是为了防止主犯被逮捕、审判或定罪。

本案关键：虽然女子带孩子搬家客观上导致了案件撤销（因为没有证人），但这并不自动构成犯罪。陪审团必须认定她的主观意图 (Mens Rea) 是为了帮助男子逃避法律制裁，而不是出于其他原因（如为了爱情、为了开始新生活等）。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A：驳回指控，因为帮助发生在罪行完成后

这是概念混淆。如果在罪行发生前或发生时提供帮助，那是 Accomplice（共犯）。正是因为帮助发生在罪行完成后，才构成了“事后从犯”。这是定罪的理由，而非驳回的理由。

选项 B：驳回指控，因为男子未被定罪

这是普通法（Common Law）的旧规则。现代法律视“事后从犯”为一项独立的犯罪 (Independent Crime)，通常称为妨碍司法公正或窝藏罪。即使主犯（Principal）逃脱或未被定罪，事后从犯依然可以被单独起诉。

选项 C：需知道男子已被起诉 (Indicted)

法律只要求从犯知道主犯实施了重罪 (Committed a felony)，并不要求知道具体的法律程序状态（如是否已被正式起诉）。女子目睹了虐待并送医，她显然知道犯罪事实。

💡 MBE 答题技巧

在刑法题目中，当涉及到从犯 (Parties to a crime) 时，请务必检查心理状态 (Mens Rea)：

  • 仅仅“在场”或“知情”通常不足以定罪。
  • 对于事后从犯，必须寻找“为了帮助逃避抓捕/定罪”这一特定目的。
  • 如果题目中的行为（如搬家）可能有多种解释，正确答案通常会要求陪审团确认其犯罪意图。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
A man decided to rob a bank to pay off his crippling loan debt, so he purchased a gun, a mask, and some duffel bags. The man then told his friend that he had decided to rob a local bank and was going to scope it out the next day. As planned, the man went inside the local bank to look around. After surveilling the bank, he decided not to go through with robbing the bank because a bank in the neighboring city had fewer cameras. Unbeknownst to the man, the friend had called the police to inform them of the man's plan. As the man was walking back to his car, he was arrested by the police.
Of what crime, if any, may the man be properly convicted?

choices.A: Attempted robbery, because he still intended to rob the neighboring bank.
choices.B: No crime, because he voluntarily withdrew from the robbery.
choices.C: No crime, because his conduct did not exceed mere preparation.
choices.D: Robbery, because he committed an act in furtherance of that crime.

questions.explanation:
Act
(requirement for attempt crimes)
Dangerous-proximity test (common law) Defendant performs act sufficiently close to completing crime—eg, act indispensable to crime's success, act close in time or physical proximity to crime
Substantial-step test (majority & MPC) Defendant's conduct exceeds mere preparation & strongly corroborates defendant's criminal intent—eg, surveilling place where crime is to occur
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Attempt occurs when a defendant (1) has the specific intent to commit a crime, (2) commits an act in furtherance of that crime, but (3) does not complete it. Under the substantial-step test used in the majority of jurisdictions, an act occurs when the defendant's conduct exceeds mere preparation and strongly corroborates the defendant's criminal intent.

Here, the man did not actually rob a bank, so he cannot be convicted of robbery (Choice D). However, he did intend to do so. And though merely purchasing supplies for a robbery would not constitute a substantial step, his conduct exceeded mere preparation when he surveilled the bank (Choice C). Therefore, absent a defense, the man may be convicted of attempted robbery.

However, most jurisdictions recognize abandonment as a defense to attempt when a person completely and voluntarily turns away from a crime before completing it.* Abandonment is not voluntary if it is motivated by:

  • a desire to avoid detection
  • a decision to delay the commission until a more favorable time or
  • the selection of another similar objective or victim.

Here, the man decided not to rob the local bank because a bank in the neighboring city had fewer cameras. This shows that his abandonment was motivated by his desire to avoid detection and the selection of another similar objective. Therefore, abandonment is not a defense here (Choice B).

*At common law, once the defendant has taken a substantial step toward the commission of the offense, the defendant may not claim abandonment due to a change of heart as a defense.

📌 Educational Objective

Abandonment is not a defense to attempt if it was motivated by (1) a desire to avoid detection, (2) a decision to delay the commission until a more favorable time, or (3) the selection of another similar objective or victim.

一名男子为偿还其沉重的贷款债务，决定抢劫一家银行，因此他购买了一把枪、一个面具和几个行李袋。该男子随后告诉他的朋友，他已决定抢劫一家本地银行，并打算第二天去踩点。按照计划，该男子进入本地银行进行查看。在勘查了该银行后，他决定放弃抢劫，因为邻近城市的一家银行摄像头更少。该男子不知情的是，他的朋友已经报警，将该男子的计划告知了警方。在该男子走回他的车时，他被警察逮捕了。

在一个遵循普通法关于犯罪未遂规定的司法管辖区，该男子可能被判定犯有何种罪行（如有）？

zh-choices.A: 不构成犯罪，因为他的行为没有超出单纯的预备阶段。
zh-choices.B: 不构成犯罪，因为他自愿地中止了抢劫行为。
zh-choices.C: 抢劫未遂罪，因为他仍打算抢劫邻近城市的银行。
zh-choices.D: 抢劫罪，因为他为促进该犯罪实施了明显行为。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law: Attempt (Common Law)
正确答案：A 不构成犯罪，因为他的行为没有超出单纯的预备阶段。
(No crime, because his conduct did not exceed mere preparation.)
核心考点：未遂罪的认定标准

本题的关键在于区分普通法 (Common Law) 与 模范刑法典 (MPC) 对“犯罪未遂” (Attempt) 的不同认定标准。

犯罪未遂通常包含两个要素：

  1. 实施犯罪的特定意图 (Specific Intent)。
  2. 为实施该犯罪而进行的明显行为 (Overt Act)。

本题考察的是第2点：什么算作“明显行为”？

标准 普通法 (Common Law)
*本题考点		 现代法/MPC (Modern)
测试名称 Dangerous Proximity Test
(危险接近测试)		 Substantial Step Test
(重大步骤测试)
关注点 关注还剩下多少步骤未完成。行为必须在物理上或时间上非常接近犯罪既遂。 关注已经完成了哪些步骤。只要行为有力地佐证了犯罪意图即可。
踩点行为
(Scoping out)		 通常视为单纯预备 (Mere Preparation)，不构成未遂。 通常视为重大步骤，构成未遂。
案情分析
购买工具 (Buying gear)
单纯预备 (Mere Preparation)
踩点/侦查 (Surveillance)
被告人在此停止。在普通法下，这仍属于准备工作，尚未达到“危险接近”实际抢劫的程度（如掏枪、递纸条）。
普通法未遂门槛
需极度接近完成 (Dangerous Proximity)。
既遂 (Completion)

由于题目明确指出适用普通法 (Common Law)，被告人的行为（买枪、踩点）虽然有犯罪意图，但在物理距离和时间上尚未达到“危险接近”抢劫成功的程度。他还有大把机会放弃（Locus Poenitentiae）。因此，这只是“单纯预备”，不构成犯罪。

干扰项解析
  • 选项 B (Withdrawal/Abandonment): 这是一个常见的陷阱。只有当行为已经构成“未遂”时，才讨论是否可以因“中止”而免责。既然在普通法下他甚至还没构成未遂，中止抗辩就无从谈起。此外，普通法通常不允许中止作为未遂的抗辩。
  • 选项 C (Attempted Robbery): 这是在 MPC 管辖区下的正确答案。踩点 (Scoping out) 在 MPC 下属于“重大步骤” (Substantial Step)。但题目限定了普通法。
  • 选项 D (Robbery): 抢劫罪要求实际的取财行为，显然未发生。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧：
做 Attempt 题目时，第一步必须看清题目设定的司法管辖区 (Jurisdiction)：

1. 如果是 Common Law ➝ 选标准更严的“危险接近”，踩点通常无罪。
2. 如果是 MPC / Majority ➝ 选标准较宽的“重大步骤”，踩点通常有罪。

如果题目未说明，通常默认适用 MPC/Modern 规则，但本题明确指出了 Common Law，这是解题的唯一线索。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
A woman who wanted to rob a bank offered to pay her friend one-third of the money she stole if the friend would drive the getaway car to be used in the robbery. The friend agreed but made the woman promise not to hurt anyone during the robbery.
The woman then drove to a sporting goods store, where she explained to the store owner that she needed a small firearm for use in a bank robbery. The store owner responded that he would charge extra because the woman was so unwise as to confide her unlawful plans for using the weapon, and he sold her a handgun at four times the regular price.
During the robbery, the woman used the gun to threaten a bank teller, who handed over money. The gun discharged by accident and killed a bank customer. The friend drove the woman away from the bank.
In addition to the woman, who could properly be convicted of murder in the death of the customer at common law?

choices.A: Both the friend and the store owner.
choices.B: Neither the friend nor the store owner.
choices.C: Only the friend.
choices.D: Only the store owner.

questions.explanation:
Parties to a crime
Modern view Common law Definition Liability
Principal Principal
(first degree)		 Performs criminal act with requisite intent or uses innocent agent to commit criminal act Target &
foreseeable
crimes
Accomplice Principal
(second degree)		 Present at crime & aids/encourages principal with intent that principal commit crime
Accessory
before the fact*		 Not present at crime but aids/encourages principal with intent that principal commit crime
Accessory
after the fact		 Knows principal has committed felony & helps principal avoid arrest or conviction Independent
crime
*Common law liability requires conviction of principal.

Accomplice liability extends to anyone who:

  • intentionally aids or encourages a principal before or during the commission of a crime
  • with the specific intent that the principal commit the encouraged crime.

Common law jurisdictions (as seen here) divide accomplices into two categories—those who were present for the crime (principals in the second degree) and those who were not (accessories before the fact). But accomplices under either category are liable to the same extent as the principal for the encouraged crime and any crimes that occurred as a natural and probable (i.e., foreseeable) consequence of that crime.

Here, the woman (principal in the first degree) can be convicted of murder because she killed a customer in the course of a bank robbery. The friend intentionally aided in that robbery by driving the woman away from the bank after the robbery was completed—as they previously agreed. And since the killing was a foreseeable consequence of the robbery, the friend (who was at the crime) can be convicted of murder as a principal in the second degree (Choices B & D).

The store owner's intent to aid in the woman's robbery cannot be inferred from his decision to sell her a gun after learning of her criminal plan. But it can be inferred from his sale of the gun at four times the regular price since the sale shows that the store owner has an interest in the outcome of the criminal venture. And since it was foreseeable that the gun would be used to kill someone during the robbery, the store owner (who was not at the crime) can be convicted of murder as an accessory before the fact (Choice C).

📌 Educational Objective

Principals in the second degree (accomplices at the crime) and accessories before the fact (accomplices not at the crime) are liable at common law for (1) any crimes that they encouraged a principal in the first degree to commit and (2) any crimes that occurred as a foreseeable consequence of the encouraged crime.

一名想抢劫银行的女子向其朋友提议，如果朋友愿意驾驶抢劫时使用的逃逸车辆，她将支付所盗金额的三分之一作为报酬。朋友同意了，但让该女子承诺在抢劫过程中不伤害任何人。

随后，该女子驾车前往一家体育用品商店，向店主解释说她需要一把小型枪支用于银行抢劫。店主回应称，由于该女子如此不明智地吐露了她使用武器的非法计划，他要收取额外费用，并以四倍于正常价格的价格向她出售了一把手枪。

在抢劫过程中，该女子用枪威胁一名银行出纳员，后者交出了钱款。枪支意外走火，杀死了一名银行顾客。朋友驾车将该女子送离了银行。

根据普通法(common law)，除了该女子外，谁还可能因该顾客的死亡而被适当定为谋杀罪？

zh-choices.A: 朋友和店主两人均是。
zh-choices.B: 朋友和店主两人均不是。
zh-choices.C: 仅朋友一人。
zh-choices.D: 仅店主一人。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

共犯责任与重罪谋杀
Accomplice Liability & Felony Murder

本题考查的是普通法（Common Law）下的共犯分类以及共犯对不可预见后果的责任范围。正确答案是 A (Both the friend and the store owner)。

核心原则：
共犯（Accomplice）不仅对目标犯罪（Target Crime）负责，还对正犯在实施犯罪过程中犯下的所有自然且可能（Natural and Probable）的罪行负责。

1. 朋友的责任分析

朋友在普通法下属于 Principal in the Second Degree（二级正犯）。

  • 定义：在犯罪现场（Present）并协助或鼓励犯罪的人。虽然他在车里，但在法律上被视为“建设性在场”（Constructively Present）。
  • 抗辩无效：朋友辩称他要求“不要伤害任何人”。但在法律上，持枪抢劫银行本质上是危险的。
  • 结论：顾客的死亡是持枪抢劫的可预见后果（Foreseeable Consequence）。根据重罪谋杀规则（Felony Murder Rule），所有参与抢劫的共犯都对抢劫过程中的死亡负责，无论其主观意愿如何。

2. 店主的责任分析

店主在普通法下属于 Accessory Before the Fact（事前从犯）。

  • 定义：不在犯罪现场，但在犯罪前提供协助、建议或鼓励的人。
  • 关键考点 - 意图（Intent）：通常，仅仅知道买家要犯罪而出售商品（Mere Knowledge）不足以构成共犯意图。
    但是，本题中店主以四倍价格出售。
  • 利益关联（Stake in the Venture）：高价出售表明店主不仅“知情”，而且通过从非法用途中获利，与犯罪建立了利益关联。这足以推断出他具有协助犯罪的特定意图（Specific Intent）。
  • 结论：店主协助了抢劫，且杀人是持枪抢劫的可预见后果，因此他也对谋杀负责。
⚖️ 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 刑法题中，注意区分知情（Knowledge）与意图（Intent）：

  • 如果店主只是按原价卖枪，即使知道用途，通常也不承担共犯责任（除非涉及极度严重的重罪）。
  • 一旦店主加价（Charge Extra），他就有了“Stake in the venture”（风险投资/分一杯羹），这直接确立了共犯责任。

3. 普通法下的分类总结

虽然现代法律（如 MPC）已废除这些区分，但 MBE 经常考查 Common Law 的分类：

  • Principal in the 1st Degree: 实施犯罪的人（女子）。
  • Principal in the 2nd Degree: 在场协助的人（朋友）。
  • Accessory Before the Fact: 不在场但事前协助的人（店主）。
  • Accessory After the Fact: 事后帮助逃避抓捕的人（本题未涉及，且通常只对妨碍司法负责，不对原罪负责）。

注意：前三者对所犯下的重罪（谋杀）承担同等责任。

MBE Criminal Law | Inchoate Crimes & Parties

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
A man told his girlfriend that he was planning to rob a 24-hour convenience store and would split the proceeds from the robbery if she agreed to drive the getaway car. The girlfriend agreed and drove the man to the store so he could commit the robbery. While the man was holding up the cashier in the store, the man's gun went off accidentally, killing the cashier. The man left through the exit at the back of the store without taking any money, leaving the girlfriend in the car outside the store to be arrested when the police arrived.
For which of the following crimes may the girlfriend properly be convicted and punished?

choices.A: Robbery only.
choices.B: Murder only.
choices.C: Both robbery and murder.
choices.D: Neither robbery nor murder.

questions.explanation:
Liability for co-conspirator's nontarget crime

Did co-conspirator commit
nontarget crime?

No → Not liable
Yes ↓
↑ No

Did defendant

  • intentionally aid or encourage nontarget crime
  • with intent that co-conspirator commit nontarget crime?
— No →

Was co-conspirator's nontarget crime

  • foreseeable &
  • within scope of conspiracy?
Yes ↓
Yes ↓
Liable as
accomplice
Liable under
Pinkerton
Conspiracy requires proof that:
  • two or more persons entered an agreement with the specific intent to accomplish an unlawful purpose and
  • in most jurisdictions, at least one conspirator committed an overt act in furtherance of that agreement.

A defendant who conspires to commit a crime can be convicted of both conspiracy and the target crime if that crime is completed. In addition, under the Pinkerton Rule, a conspirator can also be convicted of all foreseeable substantive crimes committed by a co-conspirator who was acting in furtherance of the conspiracy.

Here, the man and his girlfriend entered an agreement to rob the convenience store, and the man committed an overt act in furtherance of that agreement by holding up the cashier in the store. The man did not complete the robbery because he did not take any money before he exited the back of the store after his gun went off, so the girlfriend cannot be convicted of that crime (Choices A & C). However, it was foreseeable that the man could kill or seriously harm the cashier during the robbery, so the girlfriend can be convicted of murder under the Pinkerton Rule (Choices A & D).*

*The girlfriend can also be convicted of conspiracy to commit robbery, but that was not one of the choices presented.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the Pinkerton Rule, a conspirator can be convicted of all foreseeable substantive crimes committed by a co-conspirator who was acting in furtherance of the conspiracy.
questions.zh-question:
一个男人告诉他的女朋友，他计划抢劫一家24小时便利店，如果她同意驾驶接应车辆（getaway car），他将与她平分抢劫所得。女朋友同意了，并开车将男人送到店里，以便他实施抢劫。当男人在店里持枪抢劫收银员时，男人的枪意外走火，导致收银员死亡。男人没有拿走任何钱，从商店后门离开，将女朋友留在店外的车里，等警察到达时被捕。
女朋友可能被适当定罪和惩罚以下哪项罪行？

zh-choices.A: 仅Robbery（抢劫罪）。
zh-choices.B: 仅Murder（谋杀罪）。
zh-choices.C: Robbery（抢劫罪）和Murder（谋杀罪）均成立。
zh-choices.D: Robbery（抢劫罪）和Murder（谋杀罪）均不成立。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

刑法与程序：未遂犯与共犯

正确答案：B. 仅谋杀罪。
女友可被判犯谋杀罪，但不能被判犯抢劫罪。

核心法律规则

共谋者对非目标犯罪的责任

共谋 (Conspiracy) 要求证明：

  • 两人或两人以上达成协议 (entered an agreement)，并具有特定意图 (specific intent)以实现非法目的；以及
  • 在大多数司法管辖区，至少一名共谋者实施了一项旨在推动该协议的显性行为 (overt act in furtherance of that agreement)。

根据Pinkerton 规则 (Pinkerton Rule)，共谋者不仅可以被判犯共谋罪和目标犯罪（如果该目标犯罪完成），还可以被判犯由其共谋者在推动共谋 (in furtherance of the conspiracy)过程中实施的所有可预见的实质性犯罪 (all foreseeable substantive crimes)。

本题中，女友与男友共谋抢劫，男友在抢劫过程中意外杀人。虽然抢劫罪未完成，但谋杀罪是可预见的，且在抢劫共谋的推动下发生，因此女友可根据Pinkerton规则对谋杀罪负责。

概念比较：共犯责任与Pinkerton规则

特征 共犯责任 (Accomplice Liability) Pinkerton 规则下的共谋者责任 (Conspirator Liability under Pinkerton Rule)
适用范围 针对被告人意图帮助或教唆的特定犯罪（target crime），或在某些情况下，被告人意图帮助或教唆的犯罪的可预见结果。 针对共谋者在共谋过程中实施的所有可预见 (foreseeable)且在共谋范围之内 (within the scope)的实质性犯罪 (substantive crimes)。
意图要求 被告人必须具有帮助或教唆实施特定犯罪的特定意图 (specific intent)。 不要求被告人意图该非目标犯罪发生，但要求共谋者具有实施共谋目标犯罪的特定意图 (specific intent)。
可预见性要求 通常不作为独立要素，但某些司法管辖区会考虑目标犯罪的自然且可预见 (natural and probable)结果。 要求非目标犯罪是可预见 (foreseeable)的，且在共谋范围之内。
犯罪完成 通常要求目标犯罪实际发生或完成，才能对该罪名定罪。 要求共谋者实际实施了该非目标犯罪。目标犯罪是否完成不影响对可预见非目标犯罪的Pinkerton责任。
核心 辅助或教唆他人实施犯罪。 因共谋而对共谋者实施的非目标犯罪承担替代责任。

事实分析与逻辑应用

1. 共谋的成立：

  • 男友和女友达成协议 (entered an agreement)抢劫便利店，并分享赃款。这表明他们具有抢劫的特定意图 (specific intent)。
  • 女友驾车送男友到商店，这是显性行为 (overt act)，推动了共谋的实施。因此，共谋成立。

2. 目标犯罪（抢劫）的分析：

  • 男友在店内持枪威胁收银员，但未取走任何钱款。根据抢劫罪的定义，通常要求有财物被实际劫取。
  • 由于抢劫罪的要素未完全满足（未取走钱款），因此抢劫罪未完成 (not completed)。
  • 女友不能被判犯抢劫罪本身。

3. 非目标犯罪（谋杀）的分析：

  • 男友在实施抢劫（共谋的推动行为）过程中，枪支意外走火，导致收银员死亡。谋杀罪是非目标犯罪 (nontarget crime)。

4. Pinkerton 规则的适用：

  • 谋杀罪是由共谋者（男友）在推动共谋 (in furtherance of the conspiracy)（抢劫）过程中实施的。
  • 在持枪抢劫便利店的过程中，枪支走火并导致他人死亡是可预见 (foreseeable)的，并且在抢劫共谋的范围之内 (within the scope of conspiracy)。
  • 因此，根据Pinkerton 规则 (Pinkerton Rule)，女友可以被判犯谋杀罪。

决策流程图：共谋者对非目标犯罪的责任

共谋者是否实施了非目标犯罪？
↓ 是
被告人是否
故意帮助或教唆
非目标犯罪，
并意图共谋者
实施该非目标犯罪？
↓ 是
作为共犯 (accomplice)承担责任
共谋者的非目标犯罪是否
可预见 (foreseeable)
且在共谋范围 (scope of conspiracy)内？
↓ 是
根据Pinkerton 规则承担责任
否 →
不承担责任

陷阱警示

未完成的目标犯罪：本案中，男友虽然实施了抢劫行为，但由于未实际取走钱款，抢劫罪并未完成。因此，女友不能被判犯抢劫罪。

Pinkerton 规则的独立性：即使目标犯罪（抢劫）未完成，共谋者仍可能根据Pinkerton规则对共谋者在推动共谋过程中实施的可预见 (foreseeable)的非目标犯罪 (nontarget crime)（谋杀）承担责任。

可预见性：在持枪抢劫中，枪支走火导致死亡通常被认为是可预见 (foreseeable)的风险，因此符合Pinkerton规则的要求。

正确答案与干扰项排除

A. 仅抢劫罪。

错误。抢劫罪未完成，因为男友没有拿走任何钱款。因此，女友不能被判犯抢劫罪。

B. 仅谋杀罪。

正确。女友与男友共谋抢劫，男友在抢劫过程中意外杀人。谋杀罪是可预见的非目标犯罪，且在推动共谋过程中发生。根据Pinkerton 规则 (Pinkerton Rule)，女友可被判犯谋杀罪。

C. 抢劫罪和谋杀罪。

错误。虽然女友可被判犯谋杀罪，但抢劫罪未完成，因此不能同时被判犯抢劫罪。

D. 抢劫罪和谋杀罪均不成立。

错误。女友可根据Pinkerton 规则 (Pinkerton Rule)被判犯谋杀罪。

备考小贴士

在 MBE 考试中，务必区分共犯责任 (accomplice liability)和Pinkerton 规则下的共谋者责任 (conspirator liability under Pinkerton Rule)。共犯责任通常要求被告人具有帮助或教唆目标犯罪的特定意图 (specific intent)。而 Pinkerton 规则允许共谋者对共谋者在推动共谋过程中实施的所有可预见的实质性犯罪 (all foreseeable substantive crimes)承担责任，即使被告人没有意图这些非目标犯罪的发生。记住，即使目标犯罪未完成，Pinkerton 规则仍可能适用。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
An artist facing financial difficulty asked her friend, who worked as a security guard in an art museum, to help her by leaving the museum's warehouse unlocked so she could steal paintings and replace them with forgeries. The artist said she would reward the friend with half of her profits. The friend said that he agreed, but in fact he did not have access to the museum's warehouse and did not intend to leave the warehouse unlocked. Later that day, he informed the police of her plans. The artist was arrested immediately.
The applicable jurisdiction follows the common law for all relevant rules.
Which of the following crimes has the artist committed?

choices.A: Attempted larceny.
choices.B: Bribery.
choices.C: Conspiracy.
choices.D: Solicitation.

questions.explanation:
Defenses unique to solicitation
Impossibility
  • Legal – when solicited act would not be criminal if completed
  • Factual – no defense
Withdrawal /
Renunciation
  • Majority/common law – no defense
  • Minority/MPC – when solicitor voluntarily renounces & thwarts commission
    of solicited crime
Exemption from
solicited crime
  • Not guilty of solicited crime if legislature intended to protect solicitor
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Solicitation is an inchoate crime that occurs when a person:

  • entices, encourages, requests, or commands another to commit a crime (eg, requests another to act as an accomplice to larceny)
  • with the specific intent that the solicited crime be committed.

Solicitation is complete once these elements are met. This is true regardless of whether the solicited party agrees to commit the crime or takes any step toward doing so. As a result, factual impossibility—eg, the solicited party's inability or lack of intent to commit the offense—is not a defense.

Here, the crime of solicitation was committed the moment the artist asked the friend to help her commit larceny. Therefore, the artist committed solicitation even though the friend did not have the ability or intent to open the warehouse or leave it unlocked.

(Choice A) Attempt occurs when the defendant (1) had the specific intent to commit a crime, (2) performed an act in furtherance of the crime, but (3) did not complete it. Under the common law dangerous-proximity test, the act must bring the defendant sufficiently close to completing the crime. But here, the artist was arrested before she could take an action that brought her close to stealing the paintings.

(Choice B) Common law bribery is the corrupt payment of something of value for the purpose of influencing the action of a public official in the discharge of his/her public or legal duties. A security guard is not a public official, so the artist did not commit bribery.

(Choice C) The common law, bilateral approach to conspiracy requires proof of at least two guilty minds. As a result, a defendant could not be convicted if the other conspirator feigned agreement (as seen here).

📌 Educational Objective

Solicitation is complete once a person (1) entices, encourages, requests, or commands another to commit a crime (2) with the specific intent that the solicited crime be committed. Factual impossibility is not a defense to solicitation.
questions.zh-question:
一名面临财务困难的艺术家请求她在美术馆担任保安的朋友帮助她，让朋友不要锁上博物馆的仓库，以便她可以偷走画作并用赝品替换。该艺术家表示，她会用她利润的一半来酬谢这位朋友。这位朋友表示同意，但事实上他无权进入博物馆的仓库，也无意不锁仓库。当天晚些时候，他向警方通报了她的计划。该艺术家立即被捕。

适用的司法管辖区对所有相关规则均遵循普通法。

该艺术家犯了以下哪项罪行？

zh-choices.A: 盗窃未遂罪。
zh-choices.B: 贿赂罪。
zh-choices.C: 共谋罪。
zh-choices.D: 教唆罪。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Inchoate Crimes (未遂/不完整犯罪)
正确答案：D (Solicitation)

本题考查的是教唆罪 (Solicitation) 的构成要件以及普通法下共谋罪的特殊规则。

为什么是教唆罪 (Solicitation)?
根据普通法 (Common Law)，教唆罪的成立只需要满足两个条件：
  1. 行为 (Actus Reus): 引诱、鼓励、请求或命令他人犯罪。
  2. 意图 (Mens Rea): 具有希望该犯罪被实际实施的特定意图 (Specific Intent)。
关键点：教唆罪是一种“言语即行为”的犯罪。一旦艺术家开口请求朋友帮忙并意图实施盗窃，犯罪即告完成 (Completed)。
事实不能 (Factual Impossibility) 不是抗辩理由： 哪怕朋友根本没有钥匙，或者朋友根本不想帮忙，都不影响艺术家构成教唆罪。
为什么不是共谋罪 (Conspiracy)?
陷阱分析： 很多考生看到“两人对话”和“同意”会误选 C。
题目明确指出适用普通法 (Common Law)。
  • 双边理论 (Bilateral Approach): 普通法要求共谋必须有至少两个“有罪的头脑” (Two Guilty Minds)。
  • 假装同意 (Feigned Agreement): 本案中，朋友是保安，他只是假装同意，实际上想报警。因此，只有艺术家一个人有犯罪意图。
  • 结论： 1个真意图 + 1个假意图 ≠ 普通法下的共谋。
*注：如果是《模范刑法典》(MPC)，采用单边理论 (Unilateral Approach)，则可能构成共谋，但MBE题目默认普通法规则，除非另有说明。
其他选项排除
A. 盗窃未遂 (Attempted Larceny)
错误原因：未遂需要“公开行为” (Overt Act) 且该行为必须“危险地接近” (Dangerous Proximity) 犯罪完成。仅仅是“寻找帮手”通常被视为预备行为 (Preparation)，尚未达到未遂的标准。且她在实施进一步行动前已被捕。
B. 贿赂 (Bribery)
错误原因：普通法下的贿赂罪严格限于涉及公职人员 (Public Official)。博物馆保安是私人雇员，不符合主体资格。
💡 MBE 破题金手指

遇到“一人提议，另一人假装同意并报警”的剧情：

  1. 如果是Common Law → 选 Solicitation (教唆)，不选 Conspiracy。
  2. 如果是MPC (或题目未强调Common Law且选项无Solicitation) → 可能选 Conspiracy (单边理论)。
  3. Merger Doctrine (合并原则)： 如果犯罪真的完成了，Solicitation 会合并入主罪；但本题中盗窃未发生，所以只定教唆。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
The police had been tracking a businessman who used his fast-food chain as a front for selling cocaine. The cocaine was produced by a chemist in a lab hidden inside the factory where the fast food was made. The cocaine was then shipped along with the food to a fast-food restaurant, where the manager of the restaurant would divide the cocaine up into smaller quantities for sale to individual customers. Due to the large-scale operations, the businessman, the chemist, and the manager did not know one another. One day, an undercover police officer came to the restaurant and purchased cocaine from the manager. Upon completion of the transaction, the manager was arrested for conspiracy to sell cocaine.
Is the manager likely guilty of conspiracy to sell cocaine?

choices.A: No, because the manager, the businessman, and the chemist did not know one another.
choices.B: No, because there was no agreement between the manager, the businessman, and the chemist to sell cocaine.
choices.C: Yes, because the manager, the businessman, and the chemist had the general intent to sell cocaine.
choices.D: Yes, because there was a community of interest between the manager, the businessman, and the chemist to sell cocaine.

questions.explanation:
Chain conspiracy

Person A Person B Person C ↙ ↘ ↘ ↗

Conspirators liable for
actions of coconspirators

V.

Hub & spoke conspiracy

Person
A
Person
B Person
C Person
D ↘ ↙ ↕

Spoke conspirators not liable for
actions of other spoke conspirators

Conspiracy, at its core, is an agreement between two or more persons to commit a crime. A conspiracy can exist among individuals who do not know each other if there is a community of interest in achieving the objective of the conspiracy. A community of interest is usually established through a chain relationship where each alleged conspirator played a role or served as a link in the chain in reaching the conspiracy's objective.

Here, the businessman, the chemist, and the manager did not know each other. However, they each played a role in reaching the objective of the conspiracy—selling cocaine. The businessman owned the fast-food chain used as a front for selling cocaine, the chemist produced the cocaine, and the manager divided it for individual sale. Due to this community of interest, the manager is likely guilty of conspiracy (Choice A).

(Choice B) For a conspiracy, an agreement need not be specifically articulated (eg, verbally or in writing). It can be inferred from the concerted actions of the alleged conspirators (as seen here).

(Choice C) Conspiracy requires the specific intent (not general intent) to agree to and to achieve the criminal objective.

📌 Educational Objective

A conspiracy can exist among individuals who do not know each other when there is a community of interest in the achievement of the objective of the conspiracy. A community of interest typically exists when each alleged conspirator plays a role in reaching that objective.

警方一直在追踪一名商人，该商人利用其快餐连锁店作为贩卖可卡因的掩护。可卡因由一名化学家在一家生产快餐食品的工厂内的秘密实验室内生产。然后，可卡因随同食品被运送至一家快餐店，该店的经理会将可卡因分成小份，出售给个人顾客。由于该行动规模庞大，商人、化学家和经理彼此互不相识。一天，一名卧底警察来到该餐厅，并从经理处购买了可卡因。交易完成后，该经理因涉嫌共谋贩卖可卡因而被逮捕。

该经理是否可能构成共谋贩卖可卡因罪？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为经理、商人和化学家彼此互不相识。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为经理、商人和化学家之间没有贩卖可卡因的协议。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为经理、商人和化学家具有贩卖可卡因的概括意图。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为经理、商人和化学家之间在贩卖可卡因方面存在利益共同体。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Inchoate Crimes: Conspiracy (共谋罪)
核心考点：链式共谋 (Chain Conspiracy)

本题考查的是共谋罪中经典的“链式关系” (Chain Relationship)。即使共谋者之间互不相识，只要他们为了一个共同的非法目标而形成利益共同体 (Community of Interest)，共谋罪即可成立。

非法毒品分销链条
化学家 (Chemist)
制造毒品
商人 (Businessman)
提供掩护与运输
经理 (Manager)
分销给顾客 (本案被告)
🔗
虽然互不相识，但每一环的成功都依赖于整个链条的运作。

为什么选 D？

正确答案是 D。这基于著名的判例原则（如 United States v. Bruno）。

在毒品走私或分销案件中，通常被视为链式共谋 (Chain Conspiracy)。虽然经理可能不知道化学家或商人的具体身份，但他知道：

  1. 毒品不会凭空出现（必然有人生产和运输）；
  2. 他是这个庞大非法计划中的一环；
  3. 他的成功（销售获利）依赖于其他人的成功。

这种相互依赖关系构成了利益共同体 (Community of Interest)。法律推定这种情况下存在“协议”，因为每个参与者都通过行动加入到了这个持续的非法计划中。

干扰项陷阱

选项 A 错误 互不相识 (Did not know one another)：
这是 MBE 最常见的干扰项。共谋不需要所有成员面对面开会。在链式共谋中，只要知道自己是更大计划的一部分即可，无需知道其他同伙的具体身份。
选项 B 错误 没有协议 (No agreement)：
共谋罪的“协议”可以是推定的 (Implied)。通过各方协调一致的行动（Concerted actions）——生产、运输、分销——可以推断出协议的存在。
选项 C 错误 概括意图 (General Intent)：
这是一个法律术语陷阱。共谋罪是特定意图犯罪 (Specific Intent Crime)。被告必须具有达成协议的意图 以及 实现非法目标的意图。选项 C 错误地将其描述为概括意图。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip):
遇到涉及多人分工的犯罪（特别是毒品、走私），首先判断结构：
  • 链式 (Chain): 像本题，彼此依赖，通常视为一个大共谋。
  • 轮辐式 (Wheel): 一个中心人物与多个独立互不相干的人交易（如高利贷者借钱给互不认识的借款人）。如果没有共同利益，通常视为多个独立的小共谋。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
An 18-year-old female and a 15-year-old male, who had known each other since early childhood, agreed to have sexual intercourse and did so. The applicable jurisdiction defines rape as "sexual intercourse with another person (i) without that person's consent or (ii) who is less than 16 years old." This jurisdiction also follows the common-law approach to conspiracy.
Can the female properly be charged with conspiracy to commit rape?

choices.A: No, because the male is a member of the protected class.
choices.B: No, because the sexual intercourse was consensual.
choices.C: Yes, because the female knew that the male was only 15 years old.
choices.D: Yes, because the male was less than 16 years old.

questions.explanation:
Conspiracy
Agreement Overt act
Majority view
(modern & MPC)		 Unilateral approach – at least one person specifically intends to enter agreement At least one conspirator must commit overt act
Minority view
(common law)		 Bilateral approach – two or more persons specifically intend to enter agreement Not required
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Common-law jurisdictions follow the bilateral approach to conspiracy. This approach requires proof that two or more persons intended to enter into an agreement with the specific intent to accomplish a criminal act—i.e., two guilty minds. But when the agreed-upon act was criminalized to protect a certain class of persons, members of that class cannot supply a guilty mind. As a result, a member of the protected class cannot be part of a conspiracy.

Here, this jurisdiction recognizes the crime of rape as "sexual intercourse with another person [. . .] who is less than 16 years old." And here, the 18-year-old female and a 15-year-old male agreed to have sexual intercourse and did so. But this jurisdiction follows the bilateral approach to conspiracy, which requires two guilty minds. And because the male is a member of the protected class—i.e., he is less than 16 years old—he cannot be part of a conspiracy (Choice D). Therefore, the female cannot properly be charged with conspiracy to commit rape.*

*Wharton's Rule bars liability for conspiracy to commit a crime that requires at least two culpable parties (e.g., dueling, adultery) where the crime is completed by only the necessary number of parties. But here, only one culpable party is required to commit rape. Additionally, the male cannot be culpable under the rape statute.

(Choice B) It is irrelevant that the sexual intercourse between the female and the male was consensual, as consent does not negate an element of the crime of conspiracy to commit rape. Additionally, the male's consent would be ineffective because the male is a victim whom the statute seeks to protect.

(Choice C) Even though the female knew that the male was only 15 years old, this jurisdiction requires two guilty minds for a conviction of conspiracy. And because the male is a member of the class of persons the statute seeks to protect, he cannot supply one of those minds.

📌 Educational Objective

The bilateral approach to conspiracy requires proof that two or more persons intended to enter into an agreement with the specific intent to accomplish a criminal act. But when the act was criminalized to protect a certain class of persons, a member of the protected class cannot be part of a conspiracy.

📚 References
  • § 8:9. Capacity of parties, 1 Wharton's Criminal Law § 8:9 (16th ed.)
questions.zh-question:
一名18岁女性和一名15岁男性，自幼相识，同意并发生了性交。适用司法管辖区将强奸（rape）定义为“与他人发生性交，且(i)未经该人同意，或(ii)该人未满16岁”。该司法管辖区还遵循普通法（common-law）的共谋（conspiracy）方法。
该女性是否可以被适当指控共谋强奸（conspiracy to commit rape）？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为该男性是受保护阶层（protected class）的成员。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为性交是双方同意的（consensual）。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为该女性知道该男性只有15岁。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为该男性未满16岁。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

刑法与程序: 预备犯与共犯

正确答案：A
不能，因为男性受害者属于受保护阶层。

核心法律规则

共谋罪的普通法双边方法与受保护阶层原则

普通法司法管辖区遵循共谋罪的双边方法 (bilateral approach to conspiracy)。这种方法要求证明两人或多人意图达成协议，并具有实施犯罪行为的特定意图，即需要“两个犯罪意图 (two guilty minds)”。然而，当约定的行为被刑事化是为了保护某一特定阶层的人时，该阶层的成员不能提供“犯罪意图”。因此，受保护阶层的成员不能成为共谋罪的参与者。

概念比较表

共谋 协议 (Agreement) 公开行为 (Overt act)
多数观点
(现代法与MPC)		 单边方法 – 至少一人明确意图达成协议 至少一名共谋者必须实施公开行为
少数观点
(普通法)		 双边方法 – 两人或多人明确意图达成协议 不要求

案件事实与法律适用

本案中，一名18岁女性和一名15岁男性同意并发生了性行为。该司法管辖区将强奸定义为“与另一人发生性行为，且该人(i)未经同意或(ii)年龄小于16岁”。同时，该司法管辖区遵循普通法共谋的双边方法。

  1. 确定犯罪类型：根据定义，与16岁以下的人发生性行为构成强奸罪（即法定强奸）。本案中男性15岁，因此属于法定强奸的受害者。
  2. 确定共谋方法：该司法管辖区遵循普通法共谋的双边方法，这意味着需要“两个犯罪意图”才能构成共谋。
  3. 识别受保护阶层：强奸罪的定义明确将“小于16岁”的人列为受保护阶层。本案中的男性15岁，因此是该法律旨在保护的受害者。
  4. 适用受保护阶层原则：根据普通法共谋原则，当一项罪行旨在保护某一特定阶层的人时，该阶层的成员不能提供共谋所需的“犯罪意图”。因此，15岁的男性不能被视为具有共谋强奸的犯罪意图。
  5. 结论：由于男性受害者不能提供共谋所需的“犯罪意图”，女性无法与他形成“两个犯罪意图”的共谋。因此，女性不能被指控共谋强奸罪。

分析图示

女性 (18岁)
↓
意图达成协议 (犯罪意图)
↓
共谋强奸 (法定强奸)
↓
男性 (15岁)
↓
属于受保护阶层 (小于16岁)
↓
不能提供“犯罪意图”
↓
无法形成“两个犯罪意图”
↓
无共谋罪

陷阱警示：沃顿规则 (Wharton's Rule)

原解释中提及的沃顿规则 (Wharton's Rule) 规定，如果一项犯罪本身就要求至少两名有罪方才能完成（例如，决斗、通奸），并且该犯罪仅由必要数量的当事人完成，则不能再额外指控共谋罪。然而，本案中的强奸罪仅需要一名有罪方（即施暴者）即可完成，受害者并非有罪方。此外，根据上述受保护阶层原则，男性受害者在强奸罪法规下不能被视为有罪方。因此，沃顿规则不适用于本案，本案的关键在于受保护阶层原则。

正确答案与干扰项排除

A. 不能，因为男性受害者属于受保护阶层。

正确。根据普通法共谋的双边方法，当犯罪旨在保护某一特定阶层的人时，该阶层的成员不能提供“犯罪意图”。本案中，强奸罪旨在保护16岁以下的人，男性受害者15岁，因此属于受保护阶层，不能成为共谋的参与者。由于缺乏“两个犯罪意图”，共谋罪无法成立。

B. 不能，因为性行为是双方同意的。

错误。性行为是否经同意与本案无关。本案中的强奸罪是法定强奸 (statutory rape)，其构成要素是受害者年龄小于16岁，而非缺乏同意。即使男性同意，由于他属于法律旨在保护的受害者，其同意在法律上是无效的，不能消除强奸罪的要素，也不能提供共谋所需的“犯罪意图”。

C. 可以，因为女性知道男性只有15岁。

错误。即使女性知道男性只有15岁，这表明她具有实施法定强奸的意图，但本司法管辖区遵循普通法共谋的双边方法，要求“两个犯罪意图”。由于男性是法律旨在保护的阶层成员，他不能提供其中一个犯罪意图，因此共谋罪无法成立。

D. 可以，因为男性小于16岁。

错误。男性小于16岁是构成法定强奸的要素，但根据普通法共谋的双边方法，男性作为受保护阶层成员，不能提供共谋所需的“犯罪意图”。因此，女性不能被指控共谋强奸罪。

考试技巧

在MBE考试中遇到共谋罪问题时，务必区分普通法（双边方法）和现代法/MPC（单边方法）。对于普通法，如果犯罪旨在保护特定阶层，该阶层成员不能提供共谋所需的“犯罪意图”，从而阻止共谋罪的成立。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
A woman wanted to make some money, so she decided to sell cocaine. She asked her neighbor, who was reputed to have access to illegal drugs, to supply her with cocaine so she could resell it. The neighbor agreed and sold the woman a bag of white powder. The woman then repackaged the white powder into smaller containers and sold one to an undercover police officer who promptly arrested the woman. The woman immediately confessed and said that her neighbor was her supplier. Upon examination, the white powder was found not to be cocaine or any type of illegal substance.
If the neighbor knew the white powder was not cocaine but the woman believed it was, which of the following is correct?

choices.A: Both the neighbor and the woman are guilty of attempting to sell cocaine.
choices.B: The neighbor is guilty of attempting to sell cocaine, but the woman is not.
choices.C: The neighbor is not guilty of attempting to sell cocaine, but the woman is.
choices.D: Neither the neighbor nor the woman is guilty of attempting to sell cocaine.

questions.explanation:
Defenses to attempt
Impossibility
  • Legal – intended act would not be criminal if completed
  • Factual (no defense) – unknown condition prevents completion of intended crime
Abandonment
  • Majority/common law (no defense) – attempt complete once overt act committed
  • Minority/MPC – voluntary & complete withdrawal from crime
MPC = Model Penal Code.

A defendant is guilty of an attempted crime if he/she had the specific intent to commit a crime, performed an act in furtherance of that crime, but did not complete it. This is true even when an unknown condition makes it factually impossible to complete the intended crime. Therefore, factual impossibility is never a defense to attempt.

Here, the neighbor did not have the specific intent to sell cocaine because he knew that the white powder was not cocaine. Therefore, he is not guilty of this attempted crime (Choices A & B). In contrast, the woman believed that the white powder was cocaine when she repackaged it and sold some to an undercover police officer. And though it was factually impossible for her to actually sell cocaine, this is no defense to attempt. As a result, only the woman is guilty of attempting to sell cocaine (Choice D).

📌 Educational Objective

Attempt requires proof that the defendant (1) had the specific intent to commit a crime, (2) performed an act in furtherance of that crime, but (3) did not complete it. And the defendant can be convicted of attempt even if it was factually impossible to complete the intended crime.
questions.zh-question:
一名女子想赚钱，于是决定贩卖可卡因。她请求她的邻居为她提供可卡因用于转售，据传该邻居有渠道获取非法药物。邻居同意了，并卖给该女子一袋白色粉末。该女子随后将白色粉末分装到更小的容器中，并将其中一份卖给了一名卧底警察，警察随即逮捕了她。该女子立即招供，并称她的邻居是她的供应商。经检验，该白色粉末并非可卡因或任何类型的非法物质。

如果邻居知道该白色粉末不是可卡因，而女子相信它是，那么以下哪项陈述是正确的？

zh-choices.A: 邻居和女子都犯有贩卖可卡因未遂罪。
zh-choices.B: 邻居犯有贩卖可卡因未遂罪，但女子没有。
zh-choices.C: 邻居没有犯贩卖可卡因未遂罪，但女子犯了此罪。
zh-choices.D: 邻居和女子都没有犯贩卖可卡因未遂罪。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

未遂罪 (Attempt) 与 不能犯 (Impossibility)
正确答案：C 邻居无罪，女子有罪。

本题考察的是刑法中未遂罪 (Attempt) 的两个核心要素：特定意图 (Specific Intent) 和 事实上的不能犯 (Factual Impossibility)。

未遂罪的构成要件 Elements of Attempt

根据普通法和模范刑法典 (MPC)，未遂罪需要满足两个条件：

  1. 特定意图 (Specific Intent)：被告必须主观上明确想要实施该犯罪行为。
  2. 明显行为 (Overt Act)：被告实施了超越“单纯准备”的行为，向犯罪完成迈出了实质性的一步。

案情详细分析

1. 邻居 (The Neighbor)
判定：无罪 (Not Guilty)

理由：缺乏特定意图 (Lack of Specific Intent)。

虽然邻居卖了粉末，但他明知那不是可卡因。因此，他主观上并没有“贩卖受控物质”的意图。他可能犯有诈骗罪 (Fraud) 或盗窃罪 (Theft by deception)，但在“贩卖可卡因未遂”这一特定指控上，由于缺乏该罪名的特定犯罪意图，他不能被定罪。

2. 女子 (The Woman)
判定：有罪 (Guilty)

理由：事实上的不能犯不是抗辩理由 (Factual Impossibility is no defense)。

  • 意图：她相信那是可卡因，并且意图出售。她具备了特定意图。
  • 行为：她购买、分装并出售给警察。这构成了明显行为。
  • 抗辩无效：虽然事实上那不是毒品（导致犯罪在客观上不可能完成），但这属于事实上的不能犯 (Factual Impossibility)。在刑法中，只要被告认为事实如其所想便能构成犯罪，那么事实上的障碍不能作为未遂罪的抗辩理由。
不能犯的类型辨析 Impossibility Defenses

MBE 常考陷阱：区分“事实不能”与“法律不能”。

  • 事实上的不能犯 (Factual Impossibility)：
    ❌ 不是抗辩理由 (有罪)。
    例子：想偷钱但这人口袋是空的；想杀人但枪里没子弹；想卖毒品但那是面粉（本题情况）。
  • 法律上的不能犯 (Legal Impossibility)：
    ✅ 是抗辩理由 (无罪)。
    例子：被告认为自己在犯罪，但实际上法律并没有禁止该行为。例如，某人打猎时以为该季节禁止打猎（意图偷猎），但实际上法律允许此时打猎。因为行为本身合法，即便他有“犯罪心理”，也不构成未遂。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理未遂罪 (Attempt) 题目时，请遵循以下步骤：

  1. 先看主观意图 (Mens Rea)：如果被告知道事实真相（如邻居知道是假药），就没有特定意图，直接排除未遂罪。
  2. 再看客观障碍：如果被告有犯罪意图，但因客观原因失败（如买到假药、枪支故障），这是“事实上的不能犯”，必须判有罪。

questions.subject: Criminal Law and Procedure
questions.question:
A businesswoman decided to destroy an old warehouse that she owned because the taxes on the structure exceeded the income that she could receive from it. She crept into the building in the middle of the night with a can of gasoline and a fuse and set the fuse timer for 30 minutes. She then left the building. The fuse failed to ignite, and the building was not harmed.
Arson is defined in this jurisdiction as "the intentional burning of any building or structure of another, without the consent of the owner." The businesswoman believed, however, that burning one's own building was arson, having been so advised by her lawyer.
Has the businesswoman committed attempted arson?

choices.A: No, because even if her actions had every consequence she intended, they would not have constituted arson.
choices.B: No, because her mistake negated a necessary mental state.
choices.C: Yes, because a mistake of law even on the advice of an attorney is no defense.
choices.D: Yes, because factual impossibility is no defense.

questions.explanation:
Defenses to attempt
Impossibility
  • Legal – intended act would not be criminal if completed
  • Factual (no defense) – unknown condition prevents completion of intended crime
Abandonment
  • Majority/common law (no defense) – attempt complete once overt act committed
  • Minority/MPC – voluntary & complete withdrawal from crime
MPC = Model Penal Code.
Attempt occurs when a person:
  • has the specific intent to commit a crime
  • performs an act in furtherance of the intended crime but
  • does not complete it.

Legal impossibility is a defense to attempt if the intended act would not be criminal even if completed.
That is because it is no crime to commit an act that is not a crime.

Here, the businesswoman decided to burn down her warehouse (specific intent). She crept into the warehouse with a can of gasoline and a fuse, then set a fuse timer (acts). However, the fuse did not ignite (incomplete crime). But even if she had successfully burned her warehouse, this jurisdiction limits arson to the intentional burning of another's building. Therefore, her attempted act would not have been criminal even if completed (legal impossibility).

(Choice B)  A defendant's honest but mistaken belief is a defense to specific intent crimes (eg, attempt) when that belief negates the specific intent (ie, mistake of fact). But since the businesswoman's mistaken belief did not prevent her from forming the specific intent to burn down her warehouse, it is not a defense here.

(Choice C)  Mistake or ignorance of the law is almost never a defense to criminal liability—even when a person relies on the advice of an attorney. But the businesswoman did not commit attempted arson because her intended act (even if completed) would not amount to arson in this jurisdiction.

(Choice D)  Factual impossibility arises when an unknown fact or circumstance prevents the defendant from completing the intended crime (eg, the malfunctioning fuse) and is never a defense to attempt. But legal impossibility (eg, burning one's building) is always a defense to attempt.

📌 Educational Objective

Legal impossibility is a defense to attempt when a person's intended act would not constitute a crime if completed.
